svg.aria-label: Ideal electrolyte at 25 °C with fixed aqueous permittivity. A shows inverse-square-root screening length; B fixes surface potential at −15 mV and places the dashed slipping plane 1 nm out; C shows κa, not measurement accuracy. Contours 1 and 100 are scale references.
